description:
What moved for a site: its weekly briefing (this week's moves, up to 5 priced fixes), citations gained or lost per question and engine since the run before (for a loss, who was cited instead), tracked Google keywords that moved, and the latest crawl vs the one before.

Billing: free — reads stored results; works at a zero balance.

When to call: at the start of a session about a site, when the user asks what changed, or after a monitor run.

Returns { briefing: {week_of, headline, stats, summary, findings, offers, dashboard_url} | null, briefing_status?, site_id, domain, headline (relay it), citations: {current, previous, compared_cells, cited_before, cited_after, gained: [{prompt, engine, brand_url}], lost: [{prompt, engine, cited_instead, competitors_named}], mention_gained, mention_lost} | null, keywords: {tracked, up, down, unchanged, dropped_out, entered, moved: [{keyword, position, previous_position, change, url}]} | null, monitor | null, crawl: {site_health, health_delta, new_errors, fixed_errors, top_new_errors} | null, next_step, suggested_next? }. Spot checks (under 3 questions, no monitor) aren't compared. Relay the briefing's fixes with prices; run one only if the user agrees.

audit_id.description: Optional: the audit to treat as current (one of the site's 25 newest completed audits). Default: the newest.

domain.description: The site's domain, e.g. "acme.com" — instead of site_id.

name: get_changes
title: What changed since last time: weekly briefing, citations and Google ranks
